current.text: Barlow has a back problem and has not appeared in preseason. Yahoo lists him as questionable with a back injury.
Philadelphia's backup center group is thin. Hukporti is out for the season, and Adem Bona and Tacko Fall are injured.
Barlow is one option to replace Embiid when Embiid is injured, because Bona is also hurt.
He is only worth adding if he becomes the starting center.

durable.text: He is a low-usage big who gives about one steal and one block, with okay rebounds. His spot starts last season were underwhelming, so even a bigger role may not make him useful.

note: Barlow is not a draft target for us. Yahoo ranks him 276th with a value of 0 USD, well outside the 144 players we draft, and he has no ESPN price. His projected 6.0 points and 4.3 rebounds give no category real help, and his back problem keeps him out of preseason. Watch him on waivers early in the season: if his back is fine and he starts at center while Embiid sits, he can be a short-term streamer for steals, blocks and low turnovers.
